# [TASK] Implement Discovery Service (Eureka Server)

## Task
Standalone Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka Server, so other services find each
other by name instead of a hardcoded URL.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The server listens on 8761 and `/actuator/health` returns UP
      (`EurekaServerIntegrationTest`)
- [x] It runs standalone: `register-with-eureka` and `fetch-registry` are both
      false, because it is the registry rather than a client of one
      (`backend/discovery-service/src/main/resources/application.yml`,
      lines 16-17)
- [x] Other services register and appear in the registry
      (`EurekaServerIntegrationTest`)
- [x] The context loads and Prometheus metrics are exposed
      (`DiscoveryServiceApplicationTests`, `PrometheusEndpointTest`)
- [x] The multi-stage Dockerfile builds
      (`docker build -f backend/discovery-service/Dockerfile .`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4
